title: Boosting Semantic Segmentation with Semantic Boundaries (SBCB)
mechanism: An auxiliary semantic-boundary-detection head on multi-scale backbone features. It conditions the backbone during training and is dropped at inference.
adaptation: Boundary targets come from the 24-class mask (2 px class edges), with crack excluded or replaced by a 3 px dilated crack band because a crack is all boundary. Attach to ResNet-34 layers 1 to 4. Aimed at gridline, edge_dark, border, material and inactive edges.
min_experiment: Arm: house + SBCB head. Baseline: house (5 seeds). Metrics: mIoU_rob, gridline, edge_dark and material IoU. Kill if the mIoU_rob gain is < 0.01 and no weak class rises by >= 0.03.
evidence: R: Cityscapes +0.5 to +3.0 IoU and boundary F +1.6 to +4.1, across several heads and backbones including ViTs.
prior_overlap: none. Edge formulations are listed as never tried.
